units.title: What is a River?
units.description: A large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.
steps: Imagine a long path of flowing water.
Understand that rivers usually start in high places like mountains.
Observe that water always flows downwards.

units.title: Where does River Water go?
steps: Tracing a river path on a map.
Identifying the 'mouth' of the river where it meets the sea.
Realizing that many rivers join together.
